name: Animate Shackles
description: Scaleweaving warps the mine's iron — chains erupt from wall and floor. One creature within 30 ft makes a DC 14 Dexterity save or takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained. Nothing on a success. Manual: the target can repeat the escape attempt (DC 14 Athletics or Acrobatics) at the end of each of its turns — remove the effect on a success. 3/day.

name: Bracers of Defense
description: While worn, your Armor Class increases by 2.

name: Cave-In
description: Snaps a weak support — the roof comes down. Up to 2 creatures within 15 ft make a DC 13 Dexterity save: 3d6 bludgeoning on a fail (half on a success) and a failed save also knocks the target prone. 1/day.

name: Drop the Prop
description: He knows every weak support. Collapse a pillar, beam or cart within 20 ft: creatures in the spill (target up to 2) make a DC 13 Dexterity save or take 2d6 bludgeoning and are knocked prone (nothing on a success). 1/day.Manual riders: the 10-ft area becomes difficult terrain (mark it on the scene); can instead seal a small passage — narrate it.

name: Emberlight
description: The last spark of the sun-gift flares. One creature within 15 ft makes a DC 13 Constitution save or is blinded for 1 round and takes 1d6 radiant damage (nothing on a success). The flash also lights the area for a round. 2/day.

name: Example Blast
description: Reference ability proving multi-target, save-each resolution. Up to three creatures within 30 feet each make a DC 14 Dexterity save, taking 12 fire damage, or half as much on a success. Each target saves independently. Pattern reused by future multi-target abilities.

name: Example Boon
description: As an action, point out an opening to one ally within 30 ft. That ally has advantage on attack rolls until the end of your next turn. Reference ability proving ally-targeted buff grants.

name: Example Rally
description: Reference ability proving macro-driven cross-recipient logic. One creature within 30 ft makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failed save it takes 10 force damage, and every ally within 30 ft of you gains 5 temporary hit points. Nothing happens on a success.

name: Example Retaliate
description: Reaction, when you take damage from a creature you can see: lash back, dealing 6 force damage to that attacker.

name: Example Strike
description: Reference ability proving attack-roll + damage resolution. Makes a melee weapon attack against one creature; on a hit, deals 10 slashing damage. Pattern reused by future to-hit abilities.

name: Finesse Strike
description: Reference ability: a DEX-based melee weapon attack against one creature dealing 10 piercing on a hit. Base for finesse/improvised-blade reskins (knob the damage per character).

name: Hauler's Heave
description: Years shoving ore carts and bodies. At-will, one creature within 10 ft, no save: it is pushed 10 ft directly away from him. No damage.Manual: no roll and no automation — the GM moves the target's token 10 ft away.

name: Pack Tactics
description: Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one ally is within 5 ft of it. Manual: toggle the Pack Tactics effect OFF on the token when no ally is adjacent to the target (on by default).

name: Radiant Rebuke
description: Derek calls down a flash of judgment light. One creature within 30 ft makes a DC 14 Dexterity save, taking 12 radiant damage, or half as much on a success. Recharge 5–6.

name: Ranged Shot
description: Reference ability: a DEX-based ranged weapon attack against one creature within 80 ft, dealing 10 piercing damage on a hit. Base for bow/crossbow/thrown reskins.

name: Rending Pounce
description: Mucknathal pounces a foe Derek has marked and tears a deep wound: 3d6 bleed at the start of the target's turns for 2 rounds. Only marked foes bleed. Recharge 5–6.

name: Searing Bolt
description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature within range, dealing 10 fire damage.

name: Squire's Mark
description: As a bonus action, Derek marks a foe for his bonded hunter. The marked creature is primed for Mucknathal's Rending Pounce. Recharge 5–6.

name: Sunbrand
description: Mark one creature within 30 ft with clinging sunlight (no save): attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of your next turn. 1/day.

name: Unshaped Surge
description: The scales flare and close over the body. Self: +2 AC and resistance to ALL damage until the end of your next turn. 1/day.MANUAL TRIGGER: cast this yourself when bloodied (17 HP or less) — it does not fire automatically. While it lasts you can speak only in growls.

name: Vicious Pick
description: A miner's pick with the head snapped to a jagged spike. Melee attack: 1d8+3 piercing, crits on 19–20 (vicious shard). At-will.

name: Writhing Lash
description: The tendril acts on its own. Melee attack, reach 10 ft: 1d8+3 bludgeoning and on a hit the target is grappled (escape DC 13 — DM adjudicates; remove the condition when it escapes). At-will.Manual riders: while grappling you can drag the target 5 ft. If you start your turn grappling an ALLY, DC 10 Wis save or the mutation keeps holding on.
